offres.extrait:
We're looking for a Patch Management Consultant to help maintain the security, compliance and stability of large-scale infrastructure environments.
 You'll work across Windows and Linux platforms, coordinating patch deployments, supporting vulnerability management activities, and partnering with security and infrastructure teams to minimize risk while keeping critical services running smoothly.
 What You'll Do: 
- Plan and coordinate patch deployments across Windows, Linux and third-party applications.
- Manage and support MECM/SCCM, WSUS and Red Hat Satellite environments.
- Monitor, troubleshoot and remediate patching and deployment issues.
- Support vulnerability remediation and compliance initiatives.
- Work closely with infrastructure, security and operational teams.
- Drive automation, process improvement and patching best practices. 
 What You'll Bring: 
- Experience supporting patch management in enterprise environments.
- Strong knowledge of Windows Server and/or Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
- Experience with MECM/SCCM, WSUS or Red Hat Satellite.
- Understanding of vulnerability management and security patching practices.
- PowerShell or scripting skills highly regarded.

About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 We are seeking a Strategic Finance Lead to provide finance leadership for our network infrastructure. In this role, you will be a key partner to our infrastructure teams, providing financial expertise and guidance to optimize our networking investments and drive strategic decision-making.
 In this role, you’ll develop deep expertise in the economics of networks, from the monthly cost of connectivity and colocation to the long-range planning of fiber and data center builds. You’ll build financial models that inform Anthropic’s investment decisions, own planning and forecasting processes for major cost centers, and translate complex technical dynamics into clear financial narratives for leadership.

offres.lieu: San Francisco; Washington D.C.; United States
offres.extrait:
Perplexity is seeking an intrepid Member of Technical Staff to take on one of the AI industry's most unique engineering roles. You'll work directly with Perplexity's senior leadership to spearhead a broad portfolio of strategic technology initiatives across policy, law, operations, and corporate affairs.

Reporting to Perplexity's VP Global Affairs & Deputy CTO, you'll occupy a front-row seat to the foremost policy issues animating the AI ecosystem. You'll also get a panoptic view of how leading AI companies operate, make decisions, and engage with broader society.

Those seeking to marry technical expertise and broader interests in law, policy, and corporate affairs will find a home in this role. You'll make contributions to Perplexity that defy traditional boundaries, with a bench of mentors who will push you to learn and grow day after day.







WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Your work will be both highly interdisciplinary and firmly grounded in engineering rigor. On any given day, you might:

 - Harness AI agents to research high-stakes policy and regulatory issues pertaining to Perplexity.

 - Build automated platforms for harvesting, prioritizing, and patenting Perplexity's inventions,…
